notes.title: [UPDATE] v1.1 - bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello, 

Thanks to your feedback and comments, we just uploaded a new update for Pang Adventures. 

This update fixes various bugs reported during the first week after the release. You can find the full changelog bellow.

Please restart Steam to make this update effective.

If you encounter some similar or new issues after updating your game, please let us know in the comments.

Have a great game!


The DotEmu Team

----

[u]The complete changelog[/u] 

This 1.1 update fixes:

- the crabs that get blocked in the walls
- the possibility to go off screen during the boss fights
- the display issues if changing DPS or Zoom in Windows
- the mute volume at first launch
- Russian texts
- score saving
- crashes and start up issues
